product.title: Volumul 13. Mitologia. Hades, Demeter si Persefona
product.description: A fost o vreme când natura era mereu în floare. Nu existau anotimpuri, și pământul își dăruia neîncetat roadele. Toate erau din belșug datorită zeiței Demeter, ocrotitoarea ogoarelor și a recoltelor. Într-o zi, Persefona, fiica ei mult iubită, a fost răpită de Hades, care se îndrăgostise de ea, și dusă în lumea subterană. Răvășită de durere, Demeter a încetat să mai îngrijească roadele pământului, iar oamenii și animalele au suferit. Dar oare ce s-a întâmplat mai departe?

### The Story of Love, Loss, and Harvest

Before a time when nature was always flourishing, there were no distinct seasons. Earth constantly provided abundant harvests thanks to Demeter, the revered goddess of agriculture and grain. Life was one of unending bounty. However, this idyllic existence was shattered when Persephone, Demeter's beloved daughter, was abducted by Hades.

Hades, drawn to her beauty, took her deep into the Underworld. The loss of Persephone plunged Demeter into profound grief. Devastated by sorrow, Demeter withdrew her care from the Earthâs crops. Across the land, people and animals began to suffer from famine. But what happened next? How did life return to the world?

This volume expertly narrates this dramatic story, following the impact of Persephone's disappearance on the natural world and detailing the pivotal moments that established the cycle of spring, summer, autumn, and winterâa narrative central to understanding agrarian society and divine intervention.
